goal.objective: Reconstruct the ended G20 worker lifecycle from durable evidence without reviving its claim or inheriting parent execution authority.
success_predicates: Prior lifecycle is reconstructed from durable checkpoint and Master Records evidence
Old worker instance authority remains ended
Any recovery claim uses a separately authorized fencing generation strictly greater than 20
Recovery registry readiness is derived from the admitted bounded authorization rather than heartbeat/G18 state
failure_predicates: Heartbeat state or G18 lifecycle cleanup is treated as execution authority
Old claim or fence is reused
Recovery executor performs parent inference work
Registry promotion itself mints a claim or fence

task.derivation_reason: Operational continuity reconstruction after the expected worker-response threshold was exceeded; recovery is separately authorized and does not inherit parent inference authority.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted StegVerse task-control execution opportunity while HANDOFF_READY
activation.claim_generation_rule: fresh fencing token strictly greater than ended parent fence 20

completion.next_authorized_action: On the first real WorkerCoordinator cycle, reconcile the existing canonical recovery task from its historical BLOCKED projection to HANDOFF_READY only after exact admitted authorization validation; mint no authority. After a non-authorizing carrier sample carries its assignment-trigger packet, a later WorkerCoordinator cycle independently acquires a fresh recovery claim/fence greater than 20, validates the ended HB25/G20 lifecycle against canonical Master Records custody, and writes only the recovery receipt. PASS completes recovery; the parent then independently re-enters execution under another fresh authorized fence greater than 20.
terminal_when: Canonical registry records recovery HANDOFF_READY from exact bounded authorization without claim/fence mutation
A later WorkerCoordinator activation uses a fresh fencing token greater than 20
Reconstruction receipt is durable and Master Records evidence is bound
Old claim and fence remain unusable
Recovery reaches COMPLETED without granting parent execution authority

constraint.owner: ecosystem-chat-orphan-recovery-worker via independently admitted StegVerse task control
constraint.machine_observable_completion_condition: base registry recovery record reaches HANDOFF_READY without claim/fence; later recovery task reaches COMPLETED with durable Master Records-bound receipt under a fresh fencing token greater than 20
